verdict.rationale: Apify's JS client docs show a single `client.actor('apify/web-scraper').call({ startUrls, maxCrawlPages })` that starts a multi-page crawl from a seed URL and waits for it to finish. The Python docs show running an Actor and retrieving its results, and Crawlee is offered as the underlying web-crawling library. missing for 10: explicit documentation of whole-site link-following/discovery (e.g. sitemap or same-domain crawling), confirmation that results come back in the same request rather than via a separate dataset fetch, independent hands-on corroboration of full-site crawls.
